messages:
Alex W: Quick heads-up — draft of the launch blog for 'Optimize' is in Drive: https://drive.redwood.example/optimize-launch-draft. Need 3 quick things before we schedule publishing: 1) benchmark claims sanity-check, 2) CTA + webinar routing, 3) legal quick-pass. Pinged people for short reviews.

Maria R: On it. Quick Q: do we keep the absolute latency numbers or switch to relative % improvements? Legal usually prefers conservative language.

Sam P: I vote relative % with a parenthetical method note. I'll add a one-line methods blurb to the bottom.

Jordan L: Ops note — CTA should land on the HubSpot form named 'Webinar - Optimize Launch'. Can we route resulting MQLs into the Growth queue by default? Also need clear UTM params.

Emily C: I can own UTMs. Proposed params: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=optimize_launch. CTA link should append ?ref=webinar for tracking.

Alex W: Perfect. Emily, can you paste the exact hubspot form slug + owner routing rule so I can put it in the publish checklist?

Jordan L: Owner routing rule (ops): if company_size >= 1000 -> enterprise-rep; else -> growth-rep. Pseudocode: ```if (company_size >= 1000) owner='enterprise'; else owner='growth';``` Will add to playbook.

LegalBot: quick-pass complete. Please remove the word "guarantee" from the headline and replace "instant cost savings" with "measurable cost reductions in our tests". Also avoid absolutes like "always".

Maria R: Updated intro and hero phrasing per legal. Switched benchmarks to relative % with a short methods parenthetical. Cut the hero CTA to "See live demo + register" to keep copy tight.

Sam P: Methods section added: runs across 4 model configurations, 3 trials each, median reported. Linked benchmark scripts in repo: https://git.redwood.example/optimize-benchmarks.

Emily C: Drafting webinar runbook: 1) Promo email (3 days before), 2) Live demo + platform walkthrough, 3) 15-min Q&A, 4) Recording + follow-up with on-demand CTA. Need slide deck by Monday for rehearsal.

Alex W: Thanks — last ask: can Growth Ops QA the lead routing automation and confirm triggers before we hit publish? @Jordan L @Emily C

Jordan L: I'll QA the automation tonight and post the test logs in the thread. Will tag the playbook in the doc.

Emily C: :thumbsup: Adding follow-up email template now. Proposed publish window: Wed EOD.

Alex W: Wed EOD works if legal + ops are green. I'll queue a final review slot tomorrow AM (quick 15-min).
